test_densepose_rcnn_e2e: test the DensePose RCNN model end-to-end with empty data inputs of varying image sizes
run_model_evaluation: run the model evaluation on random tensor images using the ModelE2ETest _test_eval method
create_model_inputs: create a dictionary with image and optional instances for model input using make_model_inputs
create_empty_instances: create empty Instances with zero-sized gt_boxes, gt_classes, and gt_masks using make_empty_instances
test_model_with_config: test a Detectron2 model loaded from a YAML config path using the ModelE2ETest setUp method
